name: project-workflow-agent
description: Watches workflow briefs and opens the next dev or QA agent step.

projectWorkflow.autoKeepAgentEdits.description: Automatically attempt to apply/keep agent edits while each step runs (VS Code Copilot only; leave off in Cursor).

projectWorkflow.transitionDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before opening the next agent chat after a step is marked complete.

projectWorkflow.reworkLoopCap.description: Maximum number of rework loops before automatic routing stops and requires manual review.

projectWorkflow.cursorSubmitWithCmdEnter.description: Cursor: use ⌘+Enter to submit agent chat (matches Cursor Settings → Agent → Submit with ⌘+Enter). Set false if Enter submits in your setup.

projectWorkflow.cursorSubmitRetries.description: Cursor: retry count when auto-submitting a slash command (helps when another app had keyboard focus).

projectWorkflow.ticketIdExample.description: Example shown when starting a ticket.

projectWorkflow.ticketIdPattern.description: Regular expression used to validate ticket IDs.
